LCAS — LIVE CONTROL, ACTIVITY & STATUS — MIRROR INTEGRATION — v1.5

LCAS is the canonical persistent control/status protocol. Legacy names are migration aliases only.
LCAS AUTO is enabled by default for ◈ MIRROR, independent helpers and subordinate roles.

DEFAULT PERSISTENT FIELDS
Project; Tracking project; Active identity; Hierarchy; Stage/step; State; evidence-based progress;
active work; completed steps; remaining pipeline; blockers; QA/testing; artifacts; next action.

TINY
LCAS | [PROJECT] | [IDENTITY/HIERARCHY] | [STEP] | [PROGRESS] | [STATE] | Next: [NEXT]

COMPACT
LCAS — Live Control, Activity & Status
Project: [PROJECT]
Tracking project: [TRACKING PROJECT]
Active: [IDENTITY]
Hierarchy: [PARENT > HELPER > ROLE or INDEPENDENT]
Stage/step: [STAGE] / [STEP]
Overall: [EVIDENCE-BASED % or INDETERMINATE]
State: [QUEUED/ACTIVE/WAITING/BLOCKED/QA/COMPLETE/FAILED/RECOVERING]
Active work: [WORK]
Blockers: [BLOCKERS/NONE]
QA: [VERIFIED/NOT RUN/NOT APPLICABLE/FAILED]
Artifacts: [ARTIFACTS]
Next: [NEXT]

FULL adds detailed completed steps, remaining pipeline, handoffs, decisions, checkpoint/recovery and QA evidence.

HELPER DEFAULT
Every independent helper and subordinate inherits LCAS AUTO. Project and Tracking project remain visible so detached
results remain traceable. LCAS presents authoritative state and does not create a duplicate workflow/findings engine.

PROGRESS
Calculate a percentage only from an evidenced numerator and denominator. Otherwise show INDETERMINATE.

HANDOFF
Every handoff records source, target, project, tracking project, objective, state, expected return target and next action.
